label: Sensor Anomalies
description: Analyzes 10,000 sensor JSON files for anomalies: out-of-range values, wrong sensor type fields, and incorrect operator notes (LLM-powered note verification).

steps.label: Load & validate data
steps.detail: Reads all JSON files and checks sensor readings programmatically against valid ranges and sensor type constraints

steps.label: Analyze operator notes
steps.detail: De-duplicates unique operator notes and batches them through LLM to detect false alarms (notes claiming errors when data is clean)

steps.label: Submit to hub
steps.detail: Sends all anomalous file IDs to /verify as recheck array
